items.pregunta: Are adult classes open to beginners?
items.respuesta: Adult classes at Dojo da Luz are open to beginners and experienced practitioners alike. There is no competition: everyone progresses at their own pace.

items.pregunta: What are the timetables for adult classes?
items.respuesta: Adults practise in Benfica on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 12:00 and 20:00; in Encarnação on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 20:30; and in Lumiar on Mondays and Wednesdays at 20:30 and on Saturdays at 11:00.

items.pregunta: How much is the monthly fee for adults?
items.respuesta: The standard adult fee at Dojo da Luz is €35 per month, with up to three classes a week. The trial class costs €5, deducted from the first monthly fee.
